overview.description: You don't need a fancy transilluminator - a few LEDs, a black enclosure box and a smartphone can beat institutional kit. A badly lit photo of a perfect gel still looks terrible, so this step is as critical as running the gel.
objectives: choose the right illumination for your stain
build a cheap enclosure + filter for a smartphone camera

steps.intro: You don't need a fancy transilluminator - a few LEDs, a black enclosure box and a smartphone can beat institutional kit. A badly lit photo of a perfect gel still looks terrible, so this step is as critical as running the gel.

instructions.title: Match light to stain
instructions.description: Use the excitation wavelength your stain requires (UV for EtBr, blue light for many safer stains).

instructions.title: Build an enclosure
instructions.description: Use a 3D-printed or cardboard black box with an orange filter over the camera to cut glare.

instructions.title: Carry the gel carefully
instructions.description: Everyone drops one eventually - support the gel fully on its way to the imager.

submission.description: Submit a clean, well-exposed gel photo with the lanes and ladder clearly readable.
